"Hey traders, just wanted to share a quick tip on how to stay ahead of the curve. 

When using technical analysis, it's essential to keep an eye on **Relative Strength**. This means identifying securities that have been outperforming the market. Think of it like a marathon, not a sprint. You want to catch the runners that are gaining momentum, not just those that are sprinting at the start.

Consider diversifying your portfolio with these high-performers, but also remember to **set stop-loss orders** and **stay informed** about market news. Don't put all your eggs in one basket!

At BroadFSC, we offer a range of investment options, including **different types of assets** that can help you spread your risk. Check out our website (https://www.broadfsc.com/different) to learn more about how to build a well-rounded portfolio. Happy trading!"
